title: What If the Great Whales Disappeared Completely?

scenes.text: What if the great whales disappeared? Their poop feeds the plankton that make our air.
Before whaling there were roughly four to five million great whales. Today there are about 1.3 million.
A great whale stores about 33 tons of CO2 in its life, and when it dies, that carbon sinks to the seabed.
Their iron-rich poop feeds phytoplankton, which supply at least half the oxygen in our air.
Phytoplankton together capture as much carbon as 1.7 trillion trees, or four Amazon rainforests.
Lose the whales, and the ocean loses a carbon pump that is worth over a trillion dollars.
